objective: Define and enforce a minimally arbitrary System calibration contract for level progression, rank review, STR/VIT/INT/DISC/CHA, skill levels and XP/coin rewards without fabricating Ron's current values or creating a second derived-state owner.

roles_before.artifact: Ron OS and claim-specific live owners remain authoritative for real-world evidence.
PostgreSQL system_events is the single mutable owner of derived System state.
system_apply_action is the shared PostgreSQL write gate for HTTP and ChatGPT-through-Neon.
Current level/rank/attributes/skills/economy remain null or UNCALIBRATED until a defensible launch/calibration action occurs.
Verified quest completion is required before progression.award; one completion basis can be rewarded once.
LifeUp remains optional downstream integration and does not own cloud core state.

role_dispositions.destination: Calibration consumes only cited authoritative evidence; game scales never overwrite source-domain truth.
Calibration metadata and resulting values remain event-sourced in system_events.
The same system_apply_action gate additionally validates canonical calibration/reward policy references and allowed scale ranges.
No production stat is initialized by this architecture change; launch/calibration remains a separate evidence-backed action.
Verified-basis semantics remain, while calibrated reward amounts are constrained by a versioned deterministic policy rather than arbitrary caller-supplied values.
Legacy bridge remains untouched and optional.

capability_probes.assertion: A ledger with no real calibration events still exposes null level/rank/attributes and UNCALIBRATED economy after this change.
All calibrated projections remain rebuildable only from system_events and no second mutable state store is added.
progression still requires an existing verified quest.completed basis and cannot reward one basis twice.
Legacy LifeUp bridge regression tests remain green and bridge code is not modified.

tests.command: Run System model/calibration tests for canonical attribute/skill scales, launch level formula and deterministic reward policy.
tests.expected: PASS without creating current production values.

tests.command: Run PostgreSQL integration tests for canonical scale refs, reward-policy enforcement, idempotency and contra cases.
Run system-cloud CI including HTTP/PostgreSQL/Docker smoke.
Run continuity guard and legacy LifeUp CI.
